definitions.explanation: Derived from a single fertilized egg, used primarily to describe identical twins who share the same genetic material.

examples.japanese: {一卵性|いちらんせい}⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一卵性|いちらんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{見分|みわ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない。
examples.english: The two are identical twins, so I can't tell them apart.

examples.japanese: {一卵性|いちらんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遺伝子|いでんし}→遺伝子：05031_idenshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ。
examples.english: Identical twins have the same genes.

notes:
{一卵性|いちらんせい} is a scientific term meaning "monozygotic" — derived from a single fertilized egg. It is almost always used as a modifier before ⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧ or ⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧.

ETYMOLOGY:
A compound of ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {卵|らん} (egg) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature/type).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一卵性|いちらんせい}⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧: identical twins (formal/medical)
- {一卵性|いちらんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧: identical twins (everyday)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一卵性|いちらんせい}: identical/monozygotic (from one egg)
- {二卵性|にらんせい}: fraternal/dizygotic (from two eggs)

USAGE:
⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧ alone means "twins" without specifying type. ⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧ is the more formal medical term for twins. In everyday conversation, {一卵性|いちらんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧ is more common than ⟦{双生児|そうせいじ}→双生児：28185_souseiji⟧.
